name: zulip-zbox
notes: Zulip relay for the fir fleet. TRACKED, not converge-managed. zboxserver is the ONLY host that runs it and the ONLY clone to release from — a release cut from the mikiserver clone produced two different v0.14.0s on 2026-09-04. Graceful reload is `systemctl --user reload zulip-acp` (SIGHUP: drain, then re-exec in place).
